dimensions.assessment: Affects airport sponsors and operators utilizing federal Airport Improvement Program grants across the nation.
dimensions.evidence: allows airport sponsors to use funds from Airport Improvement Program (AIP) grants for storage facilities

dimensions.assessment: Grants administrative flexibility in how existing grant categories are spent by airport operators.
dimensions.evidence: include aircraft deicing storage facilities in the definition of airport development

dimensions.assessment: Affects the allocation of existing Airport Improvement Program funds without stating a new total appropriation amount.
Amends a specific definition in title 49 of the United States Code regarding airport development.
dimensions.evidence: Section 47102(3)(B)(v) of title 49, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change governing federal airport grant eligibility nationwide.

importance_detail.rationale: Expands allowable uses for Airport Improvement Program grants to include storage facilities for aircraft deicing equipment and fluids.
